research_result.description: Supabase is an open-source backend platform providing dedicated Postgres databases, auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, Auth, Edge Functions, Storage, Realtime, and an official MCP server for AI tools.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can obtain API keys (publishable and secret keys) and JWT bearer tokens directly through the self-serve Supabase Dashboard or CLI without admin approval.

evidence.claim: Supabase supports API keys for authenticating access to services and data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: API keys provide the first layer of authentication for data access.

evidence.claim: Supabase supports Bearer tokens passed via the Authorization header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Bearer token from the `Authorization: Bearer ` header, or `null` if absent.

evidence.claim: Supabase supports JWTs for user authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For user authentication, pass an `Authorization` header e.g.

evidence.claim: Supabase offers a free self-serve tier with unlimited API requests.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Supabase offers four plans: Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise. All plans include unlimited API requests.

evidence.claim: Supabase provides an auto-generated Data REST API.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Supabase provides a RESTful API using PostgREST, a thin API layer on top of Postgres.

evidence.claim: Supabase provides an autogenerated GraphQL API.
Supabase maintains an official hosted and self-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a standard for connecting Large Language Models (LLMs) to platforms like Supabase.
